en: A monochrome postcard showing a small harbor scene with a river or canal in the foreground, a low bridge, quayside buildings and a steamboat moored at the right. In the background a church tower with a spire rises above the town. The bottom of the card has printed caption text and a publisher's line, with a large area of handwritten Swedish text covering the lower part.
